K17_guard: K17 cannot feed K18 because every singleton pivot tail raises K by at least two; K17 first feeds K19.

components.formula: frozen valid-pivot K14 coefficients with correct positive response sign, times 60 K4 tails
components.name: K14_to_K18_K4

components.formula: all-pivot K15 source coefficients with response sign -p/choices, times 32 K3 tails
components.name: K15_to_K18_K3

components.formula: all-pivot coefficients of the 24,003,767 combined pivotable K16 rows, times 12 K2 tails
components.name: K16_to_K18_K2

scope: Interface/cost/charge design only; no K18 collection or charge was run.

smallest_charge_only_computation.algorithm: Precompute the 77-dual charge, split by K2/K3/K4 and child pivotability, for each encountered enriched local key: four-path/closed-cycle profile + 12-anchor base signature + pivot word. Stream the four parent interfaces and accumulate i128 scalars; never construct or hash K18 child rows.
smallest_charge_only_computation.expected: roughly 333 million lookup/term operations; plausible in optimized 8-thread Rust from the 64.5-second K17 control, but not guaranteed until the enriched-key cache-miss prefix is measured
smallest_charge_only_computation.hard_gate: 180 seconds / 2 GiB / 250,000-entry LRU; checkpoint each component
smallest_charge_only_computation.why_1162_profiles_alone_are_insufficient: uncoloured cycle profile forgets anchor support, hence cannot decide whether a K18 child is killed by the 78 K0 heads
